title: SaveAttachmentInput
description: Save an attachment (img_… id from a message's attachment block) as one of the project's shared files at path, so every session and user of the project can find it later with list_shared_files/read_shared_file. The platform copies it without it passing through your working directory. Refused when a shared file already has this path unless overwrite is true. Same rules as write_shared_file: no secrets; limits 200 MB per file, 5 GB per project.

path.description: Target path in the shared files, for example inputs/spec.pdf.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing shared file with this path.

sha256.description: Absent while the platform is still computing it.

overwritten.description: True when a file with this path existed and was replaced.
